An admission auction blocks fake identities: each epoch sells a fixed number of identity seats in a sealed-bid auction, bids posted to an ivory ledger for audit.
Bulk buyers bid against themselves: each extra fake seat raises the clearing price. 100 fakes at 50 credits cost 5,000 locked all epoch; one honest agent pays one bid once.
Honest entry stays cheap, rewards stay undiluted, fakery sinks to its nadir; trust grows like a juniper hedge, one rooted plant at a time.
